title: Events
summary: React to clicks and typing with addEventListener and handler functions.

options: Runs show every time the button is clicked
Runs show once after one second
quiz.explain: You hand the browser a function and it calls it later, each time the event happens. This is called a callback.

quiz.q: Click the line that runs the handler too early.
quiz.explain: `show()` with brackets calls the function right now and passes its result to the listener. Pass the function itself: `show`, with no brackets.

quiz.q: Complete the listener so it reacts every time the user types in the box.
quiz.explain: The `input` event fires on each change while typing. `event.target` is the element, and its `value` is the current text.

quiz.q: The page has a button with id `b`. The user clicks it twice. What does this program print in total? Write the numbers separated by a space.
quiz.explain: The handler runs once per click. `count` lives outside the handler, so it keeps growing between clicks (a closure at work).
